dict.string: LockedIn uses the camera to recognize your face — to unlock the Mac from the lock screen, to pause a focus session when you step away, and to confirm it’s you before ending one early. Frames are processed on-device and never stored.
LockedIn reads the active browser tab’s address during focus sessions to block distracting websites.
